Results.ReviewText: Great quality grill, you can tell it's built well and sturdy.  I love how easy it is to use.
Results.Title: We love this grill!

Results.ReviewText: Love this grill. More features than my old Weber and easy to use. Can cook direct or indirect. Easy to add more charcoal and the thermometer helps when smoking low and slow. A classic! I gifted my old Weber which is over 20 yrs old. The kid was excited to get it!
Results.Title: The classic Weber

Results.ReviewText: The Weber grill cooks nice and evenly it holds the heat good.
Results.Title: Robert’s Weber

Results.ReviewText: Love my new Weber Grill. Have had many but this one captures the ashes so they aren’t blown on patio.  Has handles that hold cooking utensils. Grill has door to allow addition of charcoal. These features make a big difference. Thank you Weber!
Results.Title: New features enhance Weber Crill

Results.ReviewText: This is at least my 3rd in 48 years of marriage.  Does what I need it to do always.
Results.Title: Not new to Weber

Results.ReviewText: Great grill. The grill is perfectly designed to deliver accurate cooking temperatures and be very easy to maintain. The grill has fantastic heat retention and the vent system allows for precise control for smoking.
Results.Title: Great grill

Results.ReviewText: I have owned and used Weber grills >40m years and have never had any issues.  I have always in the past purchase black Weber grills (2) but my wife spotted one that was copper color, and she bought it, and it is gorgeous.  It is covered with a Weber cover when not in use, but it is awesome and full of small improvements.  Handle on one side (the correct side to pull on its wheels, improved and more durable wheels, I love the thermometer, and the safety feature for the handle
Results.Title: Copper color

Results.ReviewText: This is my 3 Weber.  I think they are great.  They do everything I need done and they last a long time.
Results.Title: Best all around grill.

ClientResponses.Response: Thank you for your feedback regarding the side handles. We did decide to change the design to one handle. We will be sure to share your comments with our team for consideration. Our Care team is reaching out to follow up. Thank you!

Results.ReviewText: I am disappointed that there are not two handles on my new 22" Weber. It is much harder to move it around without two. I have an 18" Weber from the 1980's and it has two handles even though it is smaller. I find I am using my old Weber and letting the new one just sit there. I feel like I wasted my money.
Results.Title: Disappointed

Results.ReviewText: excellent product. looks great and performs as expected. However, maintaining an even temp of 190-210 for smoking ribs is quite a challenge. i use one load of charcoal from the Weber charcoal chimney but inevitably it runs out of heat and i have to start over again. if i put in to much charcoal, i cant get the temp down low enough even when almost closing the vent on the lid and closing off the baffles on the bottom of the kettle. not sure how to get even temp for a good 6-8 hrs of smoking
Results.Title: Smoking pork ribs

Results.ReviewText: Too short, ash catch is difficult to remove and put back. Legs feel flimsy. Make it 4 inches taller, thicker legs and redesign the ash catch and it would be 5/5
Results.Title: Average grill could be better.

Results.ReviewText:
what a wonderful charcoal grill!
It heats up well and you can see the temperature within the grill on the lid.
The bottom collects the ash for easy removal.
I so prefer hardwood charcoal to gas for an outdoor grill.
The smell may be the same but the taste is unsurpassed!!
Results.Title: Terrific!

Results.ReviewText: First timer owner, but have had a quite of few grills and this one right here is the gem of all didn't understand why so much hype until I bought one
Results.Title: Satisfied

Results.ReviewText: This is my second weber grill I love it even though it's a bit pricey
Results.Title: My Weber Charcoal Grill

Results.ReviewText: I always owned a Weber pot belly grill and have never been disappointed.  This grill is designed, sized and styled with cooking at the forefront.  The only disappointment is that the cover needs a hook to hang as I am cooking when not in use.  Keep up great work
Results.Title: Copper Perfection

Results.ReviewText: Love this grill it is my favorite Weber grill cooks the food perfect and the build quality is solid a must have a grill
Results.Title: Awesome 22 inch Charcoal Grill

Results.ReviewText: Great value.  I had my old one (which is almost identical) for over 20 years.  Nothing wrong with it really, but getting a little beat up.  I'm sure this one will outlast me!  I like the new ash container too. Safer and not the mess the old open catcher was.
Results.Title: Great Grill! Great price!

Results.ReviewText: This is the second 22" Weber I've owned.  The previous one lasted 20 years despite being knocked around by storms, being doused by water, and other general wear and tear.  The only reason I needed to replace it, was because some welds finally wore through.  My new Webber is already off to a great start.  The air flow is perfect, its easy to clean, and it is much safer than my old one (ash pan).  I am looking forward to another 20(plus?) Years with my new one!
Results.Title: Years and years of use!

Results.ReviewText: I love my grill. It cooks everything perfectly with tremendous flavor.
Results.Title: Game Changer

Results.ReviewText: I have had several of these grills in the past and they work fine. The grill itself is a little thin and flexible and during shipping it gets bent out of round. I bent it back as best I could, the lid and the body itself but is far from perfect. Putting the grill together is easy and straightforward. It appears that the metal is thinner than in days past, less rigid. As a grill it works ok, even for light smoking. With minimal mass it is hard to keep a consistent temperature, but for basic grilling it works fine. The cleaning system and ash catch work well, as long as you keep them clean. Overall the design is fine and works well for basic grilling.
Results.Title: A good enough grill

Results.ReviewText: Upgrade from 18 inch kettle.  Love the extra space.
Results.Title: Upgrade

Results.ReviewText: Did exactly what i needed to do and very well built. Probably near future I will be looking fo the 26in weber
Results.Title: Nice grill

Results.ReviewText: I reached out because i had a couple parts that broke and after providing the S/N # and place of Purchase, it was still under warranty. The immediately sent replacement parts after providing pictures. Out standing customer support!
Results.Title: Customer Support was great!

Results.ReviewText: I absolutely love the taste of a charcoal grilled steak and this kettle makes it easy. The.cleaning system on the bottom eliminates the cleanup mess of burnt charcoal. Just move handle back and forth a few times and all ashes are deposited in the bottom collector. This removes easily to deposit ashes into a trash bag.  Vents on top and bottom allow shutting off air to put out charcoal fire and save residual charcoal for next use. Handle and wheels allow easy movement. Totally enjoying this grill
Results.Title: Easy to use and easy to keep clean.

Results.ReviewText: Very nice little grill. I prefer cooking this way over a gas grill. Reminds me of camping.
Results.Title: Great grill

Results.ReviewText: Easy to use, easy to clean, low maintenance, doesn’t take up a lot of space
Results.Title: Great purchase

Results.ReviewText: Had the bottom half of my grill replaced after having it 6 years.  Awesome warranty!
Results.Title: Weber replaced bottom 6 years after purchase

Results.ReviewText: Best grill I have ever owned, also uper versatile!
Results.Title: 👍🏼

Results.ReviewText: Well built and easy to put together. Extremely versatile. If you are a serious log burner you don't need anything else
Results.Title: Honest opinion

Results.ReviewText: What is there to say!! A well known classic right when you open the box. I’ve owned several over the past 30 years. You can’t go wrong with this Weber.
Results.Title: “CLASSIC”

Photos.Caption: I found it in the ash catch.

Results.ReviewText: Best grill I’ve ever had and I’ve had more than a few.  I had high hopes of this one lasting me a life time but my current (1st) caught a Stray projectile in the back yard. Idk how this will affect its grilling integrity. Guess the neighbors wanted theirs well done.  Wish me luck.
Results.Title: All around GOAT

Results.ReviewText: Incredible product, absolutely love it. Great grill for awesome grilling.
Results.Title: Awesome Grill

Photos.Caption: Scratch your screen and you can smell the wonder

Results.ReviewText: Great grill, smoker, yard style piece...you name it, the Weber Kettle can do it :) I have already made wings, thighs, steak, brisket, and pork ribs.  All delicious, the family loves it, and I love a reason to be outside. Winner winner chicken dinner...literally.
Results.Title: The Best Kettle! Buy one and fall in love

Results.ReviewText: I have used my new Webber 4 times….. worked great for flavor.  I also use a 24 year old Webber gas grill; so i am having to relearn the timing aspect of charcoal grilling.  Going to smoke a Boston Butt this week using it, can’t wait to taste the bark !
Results.Title: Excellent flavor with smoke!

Results.ReviewText:
This kettle grill replaced one that the leg bracket brace rusted through.  This is my third kettle grill.  In the past I have cooked small turkeys, hams and rib roasts all have been great  In the past they last about 15 to 20 years, hope this one does the same.

My only complaint I have with my new one is in the past they have handles so that you could pick them up to do minor moves; this one does not.  That is the reason for four stars versus five.  stars.  Put the handle back on.
Results.Title: Original Webber 22 In Kettle Grill

Results.ReviewText: I have used a weber grill for over 30 years. Over the years I have tried gas grills, smokers, and a variety of other barbecues that were either gifts or hand me downs from friends. Nothing matches a Weber grill. They are the best backyard barbecue.
Results.Title: The ultimate backyard barbecue

Results.ReviewText: Great grill just wish temp gauge on vent side .. fairly easy to put together.
Results.Title: Worth buying  going to buy jumbo Joe next time

Results.ReviewText:
I have used a Weber original kettle premium, charcoal barbecue grill and a smoker, for 25 years. This year I bought a new one. Not because the old one gave up, but because it was stolen. 
  I have done everything on this grill. I have cooked a turkey, smoked five racks of ribs at one time, smoked the best pork shoulder you'll ever eat. Grilled the best steaks, hot dogs, and burgers. It's the best charcoal grill I've ever used, and I've tried a lot of them, before I bought my Weber. And 25 years later, I'm still using that Weber. (A new one now),
The temperature is pretty easy to keep where you want it, for as long as you need it to be there. When you open and close it, to add charcoal and wood, the heat comes back very quickly. It's really easy to clean, and the ashes don't fly all over if it's windy. 
  I cook year round, and the WEBER that was stolen from me, was still like new, after 25 plus years. If you take good care of them, they take good care of you. 
Thank you.
Results.Title: 25 years and still going great.

14401001.Name: 22” Original Kettle® Premium Charcoal Grill
14401001.Description: Some things never go out of style—like the smoky flavor of charcoal, the sizzle of a summer cookout, and the iconic silhouette of the 22" Original Kettle® Premium Charcoal Grill. This grill features a built-in lid thermometer to monitor the temperature inside the grill, and a hinged, plated-steel cooking grate flips up on either side allowing you to easily add more fuel while cooking. Like all Weber® kettles, it’s built to last with a porcelain-enameled bowl and lid that retains heat and resist rust, peeling, and scratching, and adjustable lid and bowl dampers to fine-tune the heat for perfect results. When it’s time to clean up, the One-Touch™ cleaning system makes it neat and effortless—just swipe the lever to clear ashes into the enclosed, high-capacity ash catcher. Two wheels make it easy to roll this timeless classic to the center of the action, right where it belongs. Because some grills don’t just cook food, they make memories.· Porcelain-enameled finish is scratch and rust-resistant· Room to cook for 6-8 people· Hinged, plated-steel cooking grate· Lid thermometer makes it easy to see grill temperature· Adjustable lid and bowl dampers let you control temperature· Lid hook to hang lid on bowl while cooking· 2 tool hooks included on bowl handle· One-Touch™ cleaning system sweeps ash into enclosed catcher· Easy to move on two durable, all-weather wheels· Heat-resistant lid and bowl handles· Bottom, wire storage shelf· Durable fuel grate· 3 aluminum legs are rust-resistant· 10-year limited warranty
